title: Rules & Rule Resolution - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of rules and rule resolution concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of rule resolution in PEGA?
options: To determine which rule version to execute at runtime
questions.explanation: Rule resolution is PEGA's mechanism for determining which version of a rule to execute at runtime based on factors like class hierarchy, ruleset availability, and circumstances.

questions.question: In the rule resolution algorithm, what factor is evaluated first?
questions.explanation: Class hierarchy is evaluated first in rule resolution. PEGA looks for the rule in the most specific class possible before moving up the inheritance chain.

questions.question: What is the significance of ruleset versions in rule resolution?
options: They determine the order of rule execution
They control which version of a rule is selected
questions.explanation: Ruleset versions determine which specific version of a rule is selected during resolution. Higher versions typically override lower versions when other factors are equal.

questions.question: When would you use circumstantial rule resolution?
options: When you need different rule behavior based on runtime conditions
questions.explanation: Circumstantial rule resolution allows different rule versions to be selected based on runtime conditions like customer type, region, or other business circumstances.

questions.question: What happens when multiple qualified rules are found during resolution?
options: The first rule found is selected
The most specific rule is selected based on resolution criteria
questions.explanation: When multiple qualified rules are found, rule resolution selects the most specific rule based on criteria like class specificity, ruleset version, and circumstance matching.

questions.question: How does rule caching affect rule resolution performance?
options: It has no impact on performance
It improves performance by avoiding repeated resolution calculations
It decreases performance due to memory usage
questions.explanation: Rule caching improves performance by storing resolution results, avoiding the need to recalculate which rule to use for frequently accessed rules.

questions.question: What is the role of the 'Availability' setting in rule resolution?
options: It determines when the rule can be executed
It controls user access to the rule
It affects whether the rule is considered during resolution
questions.explanation: The Availability setting determines whether a rule is considered during rule resolution. Rules marked as 'Not Available' or 'Blocked' are excluded from resolution.

questions.question: In what order are the following evaluated during rule resolution: Class, Ruleset, Circumstance?
questions.explanation: Rule resolution evaluates factors in this order: Class hierarchy (most specific first), Ruleset availability and version, then Circumstance qualification.
